import os, sys, json
import pytest

ROOT = '/testbed'
TEST = '/testbed/qa_instances_eval/python-control/frdata_convert_call_coverage_suite/files/tests/qa/frdata_convert_call_coverage_suite_test.py'
PREFIXES = (
    'control.frdata.',
    'control.statesp.',
    'control.xferfcn.',
    'control.iosys.',
    'control.lti.',
    'control.config.',
    'control.exception.',
)

active = 0
covered = set()

def in_scope_module(mod):
    return any(mod.startswith(p) for p in PREFIXES)

def should_skip_file(path):
    p = path.replace('\\', '/')
    if '/control/tests/' in p:
        return True
    rel = os.path.relpath(p, ROOT).replace('\\', '/') if os.path.isabs(p) else p
    return rel.startswith('control/tests/')

def profiler(frame, event, arg):
    global active
    if event == 'call':
        mod = frame.f_globals.get('__name__', '')
        name = frame.f_code.co_name

        is_target = (mod == 'control.frdata' and name == '_convert_to_frd')
        if is_target:
            active += 1

        if active > 0 and in_scope_module(mod) and '<' not in name and '>' not in name:
            filename = frame.f_code.co_filename
            if not should_skip_file(filename):
                rel = os.path.relpath(filename, ROOT).replace('\\', '/') if os.path.isabs(filename) else filename
                covered.add((rel, f'{mod}.{name}'))

    elif event == 'return':
        mod = frame.f_globals.get('__name__', '')
        name = frame.f_code.co_name
        if mod == 'control.frdata' and name == '_convert_to_frd' and active > 0:
            active -= 1

    return profiler

sys.setprofile(profiler)
exit_code = pytest.main(['-q', TEST])
sys.setprofile(None)

items = [{'file': f, 'func': fn} for f, fn in sorted(covered, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))]
print('===COVERED_JSON===')
print(json.dumps({'covered_functions': items}, indent=2))
print('===PYTEST_EXIT===', exit_code)
PY
